# SC4SAP Program → Specification

Reads an existing ABAP program (Report / Module Pool / FM Group / Class / CDS / RAP) via MCP, runs structural + semantic + where-used analysis, then produces a Specification artifact in **Markdown** (`.md`) or **Excel** (`.xlsx`) format. Scope is **negotiated Socratically** — start wide, narrow on each turn, stop when the user's target granularity is confirmed.

<Purpose>
Turn legacy or unfamiliar ABAP objects into a reviewable Functional/Technical Spec for handover, documentation audit, AMS transition, refactoring preparation, or compliance artifacts. Unlike `analyze-code` (quality-focused), this skill is **documentation-focused**: it describes what the program DOES, not what's wrong with it.
</Purpose>

<Response_Prefix>Every response triggered by this skill MUST begin with `[Model: <main-model> · Dispatched: <sub-summary>]` per [`../../common/model-routing-rule.md`](../../common/model-routing-rule.md) § Response Prefix Convention.</Response_Prefix>

<Phase_Banner>Multi-phase skill. Before each `Agent(...)` dispatch, emit `▶ phase=<id> (<label>) · agent=<name> · model=<Opus 4.7|Sonnet 4.6|Haiku 4.5>` per [`../../common/model-routing-rule.md`](../../common/model-routing-rule.md) § Phase Banner Convention.</Phase_Banner>

<Team_Mode>**No teamMode integration.** program-to-spec targets a single object (one program / class / FM group / CDS / RAP BO) and performs read-only structural extraction — no cross-module synthesis, no authoring conflict, no incident triage. See [`../../docs/team-consultation-architecture.md`](../../docs/team-consultation-architecture.md) § 6 gating logic. Future extension: if a target's `GetWhereUsed` graph spans ≥ 2 modules AND user picks L4 depth, Type A (module consultants annotating cross-module concerns in Step 3) could be added — not in current scope.</Team_Mode>

<Use_When>
- User says "program to spec", "reverse engineer", "make a spec", "document this program", "functional specification", "technical specification", "generate a specification"
- Knowledge transfer / handover of legacy ABAP to another team
- Preparing a refactoring or rewrite (need to capture as-is behavior)
- Compliance / audit requires a written spec for custom code
- Building a WRICEF inventory with detailed per-object specs
</Use_When>

<Do_Not_Use_When>
- User wants a **code quality review** → `/sc4sap:analyze-code`
- User wants to **create a new** program from a spec → `/sc4sap:create-program`
- User wants to **fix** the program → direct MCP `Update*` calls or re-run `/sc4sap:create-program`
- Object does not exist yet
</Do_Not_Use_When>

<Session_Trust_Bootstrap>
**MANDATORY — runs as Step 0a before any MCP call or user interaction.**

Invoke `/sc4sap:trust-session` with `parent_skill=sc4sap:program-to-spec` to pre-grant MCP tool + file-op permissions (eliminates per-tool prompts during structural reads + screen rendering pipeline).

- If `.sc4sap/session-trust.log` already has a line within the last 24h, skip silently.
- Otherwise run it and surface the one-line confirmation.
- All `Agent` dispatches within this skill MUST pass `mode: "dontAsk"`.

Full spec: see [`../trust-session/SKILL.md`](../trust-session/SKILL.md).

The interview is a **funnel**: every turn reduces the remaining decision space. Score remaining ambiguity 0–10 after each answer; stop when **≤3**.

**Default opener — bundled 4-question `AskUserQuestion`** (MANDATORY when the target object is already supplied in `ARGUMENTS`):
Issue ONE `AskUserQuestion` call with these four questions in this exact order — Audience / Format / Depth / Language — each a single-select with "(Recommended)" as the first option. This replaces Rounds 2+3+5 in one UI turn. Only fall back to per-round questioning when the object itself is missing or ambiguous (Round 1) or when the user picks L3/L4 (Round 4 scope trimming).

| # | Header | Question | Options (Recommended first) |
|---|--------|----------|-----------------------------|
| 1 | Audience | Who is the primary audience for the spec? | Both (Recommended) · Functional · Technical |
| 2 | Format | Which output format? | Markdown (Recommended) · Excel · Both |
| 3 | Depth | What depth of detail? | L2 Standard (Recommended) · L1 Quick Spec · L3 Deep Technical · L4 Audit-grade |

# ZMMR1003 — Technical Specification

**Program**: ZMMR1003 (Material Stock Price Tree Report)  
**Platform**: S/4HANA On-Premise, ABAP 758, Client 100  
**Package**: ZMM_PAEK | **Transport**: S4HK905938 (existing — do NOT create)  
**Paradigm**: OOP (local classes)  
**Prepared**: 2026-05-03

---

## 1. Object Inventory

| # | Type | Name | Purpose | Activation order |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | PROG | ZMMR1003 | Main report — REPORT header + INCLUDE chain | 9 (last) |
| 2 | INCL | ZMMR1003t | TOP — TYPES, CONSTANTS, DATA (global refs + gv_okcode) | 1 |
| 3 | INCL | ZMMR1003s | Selection screen — P_WERKS TYPE T001W-WERKS OBLIGATORY | 2 |
| 4 | INCL | ZMMR1003c | LCL_DATA — static methods get_tree_data, get_detail | 3 |
| 5 | INCL | ZMMR1003a | LCL_ALV — container/splitter/tree/grid owner; methods: constructor, build_screen, build_tree, refresh_detail, run | 4 |
| 6 | INCL | ZMMR1003e | LCL_EVENT — FOR EVENT selection_changed OF cl_gui_alv_tree | 5 |
| 7 | INCL | ZMMR1003o | PBO modules — status_0100, init_0100 | 6 |
| 8 | INCL | ZMMR1003i | PAI module — user_command_0100 dispatcher | 7 |
| 9 | INCL | ZMMR1003f | FORM user_command_0100 — OK_CODE branching | 8 |
| 10 | INCL | ZMMR1003_tst | Unit tests — LCL_TEST with 2 test methods | 8 (parallel) |
| 11 | DYNP | 0100 | Dialog screen — custom container Z_CONTAINER (full screen); OK_CODE NAME=GV_OKCODE | 9 |
| 12 | PFST | STATUS_0100 | GUI Status + Title TITLE_0100 | 10 |

---

## 2. Class Design

### LCL_DATA (in ZMMR1003c) — Data Retrieval

**Scope**: Static class (no state); pure façade for SELECT logic.

**Public methods**:
- `get_tree_data( iv_werks TYPE T001W-WERKS ) → et_mard, et_mbew, et_makt, et_mara, es_plant, et_lgort`  
  Selects all MARD rows for the plant; joins MBEW (bwtar=SPACE), MAKT (spras=sy-langu), MARA, single T001W, all T001L for LGORTs.
  
- `get_detail( iv_matnr, iv_werks, iv_lgort ) → et_detail`  
  Joined SELECT returning 11 columns: MATNR, MAKTX, WERKS, LGORT, MEINS, VERPR, STPRS, VPRSV, LBKUM, SALK3, WAERS.

**Exception**: Raises ZCX_S4SAP_EXCP (project base exception) on no-data.

---

### LCL_ALV (in ZMMR1003a) — Screen / Display Orchestrator

**Scope**: Owns container, splitter, tree, grid; drives screen lifecycle and refresh.

**Public methods**:
- `constructor` — initializes mo_alv reference.
- `build_screen` — creates cl_gui_custom_container, cl_gui_splitter_container (40/60 split), cl_gui_alv_tree (left), cl_gui_alv_grid (right); instantiates LCL_EVENT; binds SELECTION_CHANGED handler.
- `build_tree` — calls LCL_DATA=>get_tree_data; adds plant node, LGORT nodes, MATNR leaf nodes; populates node-key map (sorted table, unique key = node_key) for O(log n) lookup in event handler.
- `refresh_detail( iv_matnr, iv_werks, iv_lgort )` — calls LCL_DATA=>get_detail; first call: set_table_for_first_display; subsequent: refresh_table_display.
- `run` — CALL SCREEN 0100.

**Private attributes**:
- mo_container, mo_splitter, mo_left, mo_right (container references)
- mo_tree (CL_GUI_ALV_TREE), mo_grid (CL_GUI_ALV_GRID)
- mo_event (LCL_EVENT back-reference)
- mt_node_map (SORTED TABLE OF ty_node_map WITH UNIQUE KEY node_key) — maps node_key → (matnr, werks, lgort)
- mt_detail (detail grid rows)
- mv_werks, mv_grid_initialized (state flags)

---

### LCL_EVENT (in ZMMR1003e) — Tree Event Handler

**Scope**: Listens to tree SELECTION_CHANGED; dispatches to LCL_ALV=>refresh_detail.

**Public methods**:
- `constructor( io_alv TYPE REF TO lcl_alv )` — stores back-reference.
- `on_node_selected FOR EVENT selection_changed OF cl_gui_alv_tree IMPORTING node_key` — reads mt_node_map; if MATNR leaf found, calls mo_alv->refresh_detail; otherwise no-op.

**Dependency**: Forward declaration of LCL_EVENT required at top of ZMMR1003a to resolve circular reference (LCL_ALV holds mo_event; LCL_EVENT constructor takes io_alv).

---

## 3. Tree Structure & Grid Layout

### Left Pane (40%) — Tree (CL_GUI_ALV_TREE)

**Hierarchy**:
```
Plant (T001W-NAME1)
├── Location/Storage Bin (T001L-LGOBE)
│   ├── Material (MAKTX — from MAKT with spras=sy-langu)
│   ├── Material
│   └── …
├── Location/Storage Bin
│   └── …
```

Leaf nodes are MATNR entries; clicking a leaf triggers SELECTION_CHANGED → LCL_EVENT=>on_node_selected.

### Right Pane (60%) — Grid (CL_GUI_ALV_GRID)

**Initial state**: Empty (no data until user selects a MATNR leaf).

    let anyLong = false;
